items.name: ByteStringPrefix
items.summary: Enumeration of the valid prefixes a bytestring literal can have.

methods.name: as_str
methods.summary: Return a `str` representation of the prefix

methods.name: is_raw
methods.summary: Return true if this prefix indicates a "raw bytestring", e.g. `rb"foo"` or `Rb"foo"`

items.name: FStringPrefix

methods.name: is_raw
methods.summary: Return true if this prefix indicates a "raw f-string", e.g. `rf"{bar}"` or `Rf"{bar}"`

methods.name: is_raw

methods.name: is_unicode
